title: Process flow diagram showing deaeration equipment, chemical dosing and steam generation, with principal monitoring and control instrumentation
description: Training slide PFD: demineralized water and medium/low-grade condensate sprayed into a deaerator preheat zone, steam sparge stripping in the deaeration zone, vented gases, deaerated feedwater pumped via four chemical dosing systems (oxygen scavenger, dispersant, anti-foam/anti-prime, hardness agent) to steam generation; includes a deaerator level/flow cascade control diagram.
publisher: ABB (ABB myLearning — Water Industry: Boiler Feed Water training deck)
